reader.requirement: A pointer rule: the I-O-CONTROL paragraph of the Sort-Merge module takes the SAME RECORD/SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clause exactly as XI.2.5 specifies it (all three spellings, repeated, beside the Sequential I-O SAME AREA, RERUN and MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clauses in any order per VII.2.10.3 SR1, the paragraph closed by one period), with XI.2.5's syntax and general rules applied to it.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a report file may appear in any number of SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses (XIII.2.4.3 SR2); from 2002 it is barred from them; sort-merge and plain-file rows are the same at every edition

reader.notes: The grammar's ioControlParagraph takes any sequence of SAME, RERUN, MULTIPLE FILE and APPLY COMMIT clauses; BindIoControl records each SAME format's membership and ScreenSameOperands/ScreenSameClauses ask XI.2.5.3's rules.
